latest.title: Real-time BVM feedback linked to better arrest ventilation
latest.finding: Ventilations in-target for both rate and tidal volume rose from 7.5% to 39.0% with real-time feedback; with ETCO2 monitoring alone only 6.8% met both, and 58.2% of ventilations delivered a lower-than-target tidal volume

latest.title: Women still get less bystander CPR in public
latest.finding: Public bystander CPR: 48% of men vs 44% of women in North Carolina (aOR 0.87) and 59% vs 52% in Singapore (aOR 0.78); survival to discharge favoured women in North Carolina (aOR 1.15) but men in Singapore (aOR 0.63)

latest.title: Adrenaline timing not tied to paediatric OHCA survival
latest.finding: No timing window (1–10 through 26–30 minutes after EMS contact) showed an association with one-month survival; risk ratios ranged 0.97–2.94 with confidence intervals crossing 1

latest.title: ECG signs appear minutes before post-ROSC rearrest
latest.finding: 40.7% of post-ROSC patients rearrested; identification was highest one minute before rearrest (AUROC 0.74) and declined beyond three minutes; rearrest carried lower survival (20.4% vs 43.1%) and favourable neuro outcome (7.8% vs 21.2%)
